definitions.explanation: The quality of being charming, sweet, or endearing. Formed from the i-adjective {可愛|かわい}らしい (cute, lovely) with the noun-forming suffix さ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可愛|かわい}らしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}とれた。
examples.english: I was captivated by the puppy's cuteness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可愛|かわい}らしさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a unique sweetness in her smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧{可愛|かわい}らしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: This town has many old buildings and somehow feels charming.

notes:
Noun form of ⟦{可愛|かわい}らしい→可愛らしい：02341_kawairashii⟧ (lovely, sweet). The suffix さ converts the adjective into a noun denoting the quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可愛|かわい}らしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: feel the cuteness of
- {可愛|かわい}らしさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a cuteness about it
- {可愛|かわい}らしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧: bring out the cuteness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {可愛|かわい}さ: cuteness — broader and more colloquial; can describe pets, children, or even partners
- {可愛|かわい}らしさ: sweetness — slightly more refined; suggests gentle charm rather than sheer cuteness
- {愛|あい}らしさ: loveliness — formal and literary; close in meaning to {可愛|かわい}らしさ
